title: Karmic compatibility in the destiny matrix: the couple’s tail and its tasks

seo.title: Karmic tail compatibility in the destiny matrix
seo.description: Karmic tail compatibility in the destiny matrix: how a couple’s tail is calculated, how it differs from a personal one and how to read its three points.

short: In the destiny matrix, karmic compatibility means the couple’s tail — three numbers at the bottom of the matrix built from two dates of birth. It shows the union’s tasks: what the couple has to go through together and what resistance the path starts from. A couple’s tail is calculated differently from a personal one, so couples can have 97 different tails while a single person has only 26. Below: how it works, how to read its points and which tails come up most often.

sections.h2: What the couple’s karmic tail is
paragraphs: A couple’s matrix is built from two dates of birth, and at the bottom, just like a personal matrix, it has three points on one line. In the couple reading this sphere is called exactly that — “The couple’s karmic tail”: “Entry to the task”, “Middle of the task” and “Main task”. In Yuliana Lisovskaya’s book these are the points D1, D2 and D, the line of the couple’s tasks.

The tail is written as three numbers from the entry to the main task, for example 6-8-11. The book uses the reverse order, starting from the main task, so the book’s tail 5-11-6 is written here as 6-11-5. The first number of a couple’s tail is always a multiple of three — that is how the calculation works.

**A couple’s tail is the union’s tasks, not the sum of two fates.** It describes what two people go through together: the main trials in which a relationship either grows stronger or breaks. Whether these are karmic lessons or quite everyday ones, Lisovskaya leaves open.

sections.h2: How the couple’s tail is calculated
paragraphs: Each number of a couple’s tail is the sum of the matching numbers of two personal tails. If the sum is above 22, its digits are added. The middle of the tail is not recalculated from the ends, as in a personal matrix: it too is the sum of the partners’ middles.

The partners’ personal tails are 15-8-11 and 18-9-9; the couple’s tail is 6-17-20. None of the three numbers matches the partners’ numbers: the couple has a task of its own that neither of the two has alone.

The book has a couple born on 16 July 2003 and 1 September 2005. Their personal tails are 21-4-10 and 6-5-17, and the couple’s tail is 9-9-9. Had the middle been recalculated from the ends, as in a personal chart, it would have been 9-18-9. The same goes for the book’s second couple, born on 3 December 1997 and 27 May 1999: their tail is 6-8-11, while recalculating the middle from the ends would give 17. So a couple has a middle of its own, and it is often the middle that gives a couple a tail no single person can have.

We went through every pair of dates of birth from 1900 to 2026. There turned out to be 97 different couple tails, while one person can have only 26. All 26 personal tails occur in couples too, and the other 71 never appear in a personal matrix at all. In 50 of them the middle is not the reduced sum of the ends — the personal formula cannot produce such a tail.

**Two couples in three — 66% — get a tail that exists in no personal matrix.** For the remaining third the tail matches some personal one in its numbers, but even then it describes something else: a personal tail is about one person, a couple’s tail is about two. Readings of [personal karmic tails](/encyclopedia/karmic-tail) are not carried over to a couple; they can be read for each partner separately.

sections.h2: Which couple tails are most common
paragraphs: Couple tails are spread unevenly: the ten most common cover more than a third of all couples. Shares are of all pairs of dates of birth from 1900 to 2026.

paragraphs: The most common couple’s tail, 9-6-15, never occurs in a personal matrix. The Lovers stand at the entry in five tails out of ten: a couple’s common language often begins with choosing each other, and that is where the main task begins too.
People also search for tails outside the table: 9-6-6 occurs for about one couple in a hundred, 9-21-12 for 2.4% of couples, the twelfth most common. A personal matrix has neither.

sections.h2: How to read the three points of the tail

ul: **Main task** — the union’s main trials. It is read mostly in the minus: what is not working for the couple and what will have to change for the relationship to hold.
**Middle of the task** — how the main task unfolds: where the way to a solution lies and what brings the couple to it.
**Entry to the task** — the same point as “Common language” on the relationship line. It is read both ways: as the couple’s shared wishes and agreements, and as the first resistance to those wishes.

paragraphs: Take 6-17-20. The Lovers at the entry: the couple is brought together and held by choosing each other, but doubts start there too. The Star in the middle: the way to a solution runs through a shared faith in the future and honesty about what each of them really believes in. Judgement in the main task: the union has to revisit the past — old grudges, the scripts of their parents’ families, decisions made before they met.

The arcana of the tail are not read one by one, as in a dictionary. What matters is the chain: where the task begins, how it unfolds and where it leads. That is why the same arcanum means different things in different points.

The name “karmic tail” comes from the personal matrix, where the tail is often linked to past lives. For a couple, Lisovskaya does not frame it that way: these are the union’s tasks, karmic or simply part of life. The legend of past incarnations cannot be checked, while the tasks written in the tail are visible in the couple’s ordinary life.

In her book Lisovskaya calls the couple’s tail a karmic program outright — “a karmic program for the couple”. So a search for “programs in compatibility” is about the same couple’s tail. It is not the same as the [programs of a personal matrix](/programs): those are one person’s recurring scenarios, while here they are the tasks of two.

**A couple’s tail is not a verdict on the relationship.** It shows what the two have to work on, not how it will all end. A heavy arcanum in the tail speaks of a hard task, not of its outcome: a task that is seen gets worked through rather than avoided.

sections.h2: Where to see your couple’s tail
paragraphs: Enter two dates of birth into the [compatibility calculator](/compatibility). The couple’s tail appears at once, free, in the “Key numbers” block. In the full couple reading, the sphere “The couple’s karmic tail” has three paragraphs on your particular triple and captions for its three cards.

If the couple’s tail matches one of the 26 personal tails, there will be a link under the reading to the article on that personal tail: it is worth reading as background, remembering that the couple goes through the task as two.

faq.q: What is karmic compatibility in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: It is the couple’s tail — the three points at the bottom of the matrix built from two dates of birth. It shows the union’s tasks: the couple’s main trials, the way to resolving them and the common language the task starts from.

faq.q: How do I find our couple’s karmic tail?
faq.a: Enter both dates of birth into the compatibility calculator: the couple’s tail appears free in the “Key numbers” block. Each of its numbers is the sum of the matching numbers of the partners’ personal tails, reduced to 22.

faq.q: How is a couple’s tail different from a personal karmic tail?
faq.a: A personal tail describes one person, a couple’s tail describes the tasks of two. It is also calculated differently: the middle is not recalculated from the ends, so couples have 97 different tails and people have 26.

faq.q: Why does our couple have a tail that no personal matrix has?
faq.a: It happens to two couples in three. Each number of a couple’s tail is the sum of two people’s numbers, and the middle is not recalculated from the ends, so a couple gets combinations that one date of birth cannot give. Such a tail is normal and is read by the same rules.

faq.q: Heavy arcana in the couple’s tail — is the relationship doomed?
faq.a: No. The tail shows what the couple has to work on, not how the union will end. The main task is read mostly in the minus precisely so that you can see what to change while it is still possible.

faq.q: If our couple’s tail matches a personal one, can I read the article on that personal tail?
faq.a: As background, yes: the arcana and their chain are the same. But the personal article is about one person, while in a couple two people go through the same task, so the reading of the couple’s tail is written separately.
